summary: This directory manages the core context and configuration data required for project analysis. It serves as the primary repository for project-wide information, encompassing directory structures, settings, and package metadata necessary to establish an analysis environment.
responsibilities: Defining the scope and boundaries of a project for analysis
Aggregating project configuration and package details
Providing a unified state object representing the project environment
relationships: The Project Context integrates project configuration and package information to define the analysis domain.
The root directory acts as the anchor point for the Project Context, determining the scope of the analyzed project.
designDecisions: Use of an interface to enforce a consistent structure for project-wide analysis data
Centralized state representation to simplify dependency injection across analysis modules
